item.title: Woman, 35, died in explosion after ex-partner 'forced entry' into her home
item.description: Police officers are treating the death of Jo Shaw as a homicide.

item.title: Watch: Captain of stranded ship in Strait of Hormuz tells BBC of 'pressure'
item.description: Capt Raman Kapoor's ship is one of several to be stranded in the strait in the midst of the power struggle between the US and Iran.

item.title: Israeli court extends detention of two Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: Thiago Ávila and Saif Abu Keshek were detained by Israeli forces who intercepted the flotilla's boats near Greece last week.

item.title: Mission is to preach peace, says Pope in response to Trump attacks
item.description: Trump lashed out at the pope for condemning the conflict in the Middle East, as his secretary of state heads to the Vatican.
